Planning to buy the Vivo X Fold 6? Watch this review before you decide!
I tested this foldable phone in real life, including gaming, camera, battery, display and daily usage. From its massive 8.02-inch AMOLED display and 200MP camera to its powerful Dimensity 9500 Super Edition processor, there's a lot to explore. But at ₹2,19,999, is it really worth your money?
Watch the review to find out what makes it impressive and where it falls short!
